decision: Both complete calibrated Voyager rasters inspected. The disc near (342,507) in C1137631 is about eight pixels across; C1129120 near (271,399) is about five. Shading and detector sampling dominate. The archive geometry does not establish a reliable surface-coordinate orientation. These images do not qualify a registered terrain or albedo map.
disposition: Model-only presentation; photographic mapping remains unqualified, not absent.
